Package com.nexuslink.protocol.sftp

Class SftpService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.sftp.SftpService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SftpService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
SFTP client over Apache MINA SSHD. Connect with host/port + password (or an SSH private key), then list directories and read files. Holds one SSH session + SFTP channel for the browse session.

    • uploadFrom

      public void uploadFrom(Path localSource, String remotePath, long offset, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Uploads localSource from byte offset onward, appending to the partial remote file. progress reports the remote file's total size (offset + bytes sent by this call). An offset of 0 delegates to the ordinary truncating upload(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String, java.util.function.LongConsumer).
      Throws:
      Exception

    • downloadFrom

      public void downloadFrom(String remotePath, Path localTarget, long offset, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Downloads remotePath from byte offset onward, appending to the partial local file. The remote stream is opened read-only and skipped forward, so the server file is untouched.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • uploadScp

      public void uploadScp(Path localSource, String remotePath, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Uploads localSource to remotePath over SCP rather than SFTP, reusing the open SSH session. SCP has no incremental progress callback, so progress is invoked once with the final byte count on success.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • downloadScp

      public void downloadScp(String remotePath, Path localTarget, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Downloads remotePath to localTarget over SCP rather than SFTP. Like uploadScp(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String, java.util.function.LongConsumer), progress is reported once at completion.
      Throws:
      Exception
